No, so I think in this case Teku and Lodestar are not talking to each other and just build on their own chain. Dora just reads from Teku.
I think this has nothing to do with glamsterdam nor focil. I think when Teku is proposing, it publishes the block + data columns and bundles them into a RPC frame, which exceeds our maximum frame size (4MiB) so lodestar drops teku as a peer. Gonna spend more time into this.
